notes: Kai's Short Rifle on Tier 1's ammo system: a hitscan round read from Support_RaycastingWeapons' fields that ricochets as the gun's own fireRaycast does: up to raycastRicochets turns off what it meets, 30 more damage for each hit before, half its damage on its own shooter. While Emote_Critical is on, a player struck after a turn takes a crit (the shared rules' ricochet_shots), and every hit shoves the victim ahead and up. Its line shape's look is not read (the shape is a model, not text): the streak is drawn 0.3 wide for 0.1 s in the game's warm tracer colour.

handles.ShortRifleImage::onHitObject: engine hitscan landing at every turn: damage where the minigame allows, the explosion projectile blown up where it lands, the player or brick hit sound
handles.ShortRifleImage::isRaycastCritical: the shared rules' ricochet_shots: a player struck after the ray has turned crits, from below and not by its shooter or else to the head
handles.ShortRifle::doRaycast: engine hitscan: each leg cast over the range left in one go (its 100-unit steps only kept each containerRayCast short)
handles.ShortRifle::checkForObstruction: engine hitscan eye_within 4.5: a muzzle shot casts from the eye when something stands that close before it
handles.eulerToAxis: only turned drawTracer's line shape; the engine draws the streak
handles.ShortRifle::drawTracer: engine hitscan tracer and ricochet streaks: a line along each leg for 0.1 s
handles.datablock:ShortRifleRaycastTracer: the engine hitscan's streak (drawTracer's line shape)
